atoms.evidence: The exact bootstrap skill is control-only. Its bytes contain no scored subject, and the skill requires native create_goal ACTIVE before the only waiter can return subject bytes.
atoms.question: Is every scored subject withheld until the fresh test-taker Goal is ACTIVE?

atoms.evidence: The one allowed pre-Goal read must be sed -n 1,Np of the exact realpath skill with N covering all lines and stdout exactly equal to the bound skill; execution options carry no authority.
atoms.question: Is the pre-Goal skill read semantically closed without brittle option bounds?

atoms.evidence: The waiter receives only the Goal thread ID, independently locates that thread trace, and validates the exact task, objective, route, tool order, ACTIVE receipt, and pending waiter call.
atoms.question: Does the waiter prove its own active Goal boundary before release?

atoms.evidence: The parent performs zero actions while a test-taker is live. The waiter alone writes active evidence and returns the prebound subject after the attested ACTIVE prefix.
atoms.question: Is subject release independent of parent polling, follow-up, or publication?

atoms.evidence: Each task receives one canonical UTF-8 subject line no larger than 512 bytes, one semantic obligation, no private scorer, no expected answer, and no subject bytes in the spawn prompt.
atoms.question: Is every automated work unit small and answer-blind before activation?

atoms.evidence: Session task path, parent thread, Goal thread, turn, objective, nonce, requested model and effort, atom ID, waiter, recipe, and subject identities must all agree exactly.
atoms.question: Is task, Goal, route, control, and subject identity closed?

atoms.evidence: One turn must contain skill read, create_goal ACTIVE, waiter subject, one atomic solution, update_goal COMPLETE for the same Goal, one terminal token, and task_complete last.
atoms.question: Does one fresh Goal enclose all subject work through terminal completion?

atoms.evidence: Retry, resend, relaunch, replacement, reuse, and best-of are zero. Every mismatch consumes that exact task and row permanently with zero credit.
atoms.question: Are failed test-takers never repaired, replayed, or replaced?

atoms.evidence: The sealed active trace must be an exact prefix of the final raw trace; the final trace must reprove the same Goal and turn, exact subject stdout, Goal COMPLETE, and terminal token.
atoms.question: Can terminal verification rederive the pre-subject boundary?

atoms.evidence: The frozen roster is alpha gpt-5.4-mini/xhigh, bravo gpt-5.4-mini/medium, and charlie gpt-5.6-luna/medium. These are requested identities, not platform-effective attestation.
atoms.question: Is the exact roster preserved without overstating model attestation?

atoms.evidence: The harness must parse the observed direct-native mini trace and wrapped Luna trace as separate closed profiles, reject mixed or extra tools, and prove the same Goal lifecycle in both.
atoms.question: Are all three roster routes covered by exact observed transport profiles?

atoms.evidence: Task paths, Goal threads, turn IDs, nonces, attempt IDs, and terminal trace hashes must be globally unique across the canary and both consecutive matrices.
atoms.question: Does the full sequence forbid any test-taker or execution reuse?

atoms.evidence: A separate read-only verifier must independently rederive rows, traces, scores, inventories, route coverage, and global freshness. Accounting is last and no successor write is allowed.
atoms.question: Is empirical validity independent of controller self-report?

atoms.evidence: OMP artifacts remain frozen diagnostic-only comparator material under their separate owner. The Codex-native lane does not inspect, wait for, launch, extend, or gate on Windows OMP.
atoms.question: Is Codex-native qualification fully isolated from the OMP lane?

atoms.evidence: Matrix007, Matrix009, every consumed probe, and all non-Goal results remain failures or diagnostic-only. Static checks, reviews, canaries, and partial matrices grant no qualification.
atoms.question: Are prior failures and zero-authority evidence preserved exactly?

atoms.evidence: A three-route canary grants zero credit. Qualification remains 0/2 until two new full matrices are clean, consecutive, independently verified, and unchanged under the exact roster.
atoms.question: Is qualification impossible before two consecutive clean full matrices?

atoms.evidence: The review corpus has exactly eighteen unique obligations and closed tokens. Implementation admission requires all eighteen fresh Goal reviews plus read-only exact-set verification; it grants no launch credit.
atoms.question: Does complete atomic review bound implementation authority only?

atoms.evidence: At the first recurrence of a normalized failure family, freeze exact bytes and pivot architectures with zero patch-review cycles. The 30-minute churn audit never resets failures or 0/2.
atoms.question: Will the lane pivot rather than repeatedly patch a failed family?
